summary: Completed five authored forward/backward tabletop cases and proposed language, domain/context ownership, and ADR-006/007/008. Rejected a combined decision status and automatic assumption penalties; favored small immutable choice/justification versions instead of a heavy aggregate owning grants, sources and observations. No simulation mechanism was implemented or empirically calibrated.
reviewer: Assigned AE-002 Codex worker (author self-review; no independent domain reviewer or human participant)
review_notes: Reviewed actual AE-001 artifacts, raw observations, receipt and limitations at entry commit 1e485ef18b722ae32ff31e5943f160239e26603a; the predecessor check passed before edits. T2 demonstrates delegated discretion without world evidence and historical validity after revocation; T3 demonstrates authorized conformance with poor sampled fitness and required an explicit evaluation exception; T4 demonstrates shared origins and required separate assessment delivery; T5 demonstrates harmless unsupported closure. Every case identifies the eight required information distinctions, Actor/Role/Function, owners, versioned revisions, typed earlier parents, and backward counterprobes. All nine invariants were manually audited. See tabletop.md and review.md for concrete findings, corrections and unresolved boundaries. ADRs remain proposed and hashes prove consistency only. Updating the required ADR register makes that one AE-001 artifact hash historical; the exact pre-edit register and passing entry check are preserved, without rewriting predecessor evidence.
limitations: Worker self-review only; independent controller command validation and independent domain/architecture acceptance are not asserted.
Five manually authored toy fixtures, not executable simulations, measured outcomes, seeded experiments, human participation or empirical calibration.
Combined status, Decision-owned foreign evidence, implicit role transfer, copied-source independence, authorization-as-truth and assumption-as-damage fail the documented counterexamples.
Concrete transitions, cross-owner atomicity, replay, authority conflicts, evidence quality/independence and player discoverability remain untested; revisit AE-006/007/013/016-019 as documented.
T3 limited matched workload cannot establish a generally superior or safe payment policy; T5 no observed harm cannot establish fitness or authority outside its observation window.
